comparison.objective: Commission a rigid shock absorber versus juice a lemon and dispose of the spent half.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed unlocking, controlled collar rotation, counterholding, and iterative cycling versus bimanual stabilization with repeated compliant twisting and squeezing.
comparison.success_condition: Two measured safe stops and setting retention versus lemon squeezed dry, juice collected, and spent half on saucer. No dryness or yield threshold is stated.
comparison.reason: Shared twisting and counterholding are generic; deformable extraction and rigid dynamic commissioning test different abilities.
